## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation from weak overall breadth and mixed leadership as Energy/Industrials show strength while large-cap Technology and several Financials are under pressure; Leadership: Broad but Energy-heavy (3/5 in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.59% | 1M: +3.76%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials follow: BA (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +2.74%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging overall with notable exceptions: AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%) ABOVE TREND. Financials are mixed/soft: JPM (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.44% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, NKE (1W: +5.47% | 1M: -2.54%) RECOVERY, COP (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad but Energy-heavy (3/5 Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -9.75% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION, ADBE (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +3.25%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -4.39% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -10.57%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Technology and select Consumer Discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W: INTC (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND; note INTC shows short-term momentum but 1M weakness — a divergence to monitor.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-soft with some dispersion: NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W performance is negative and breadth is weak.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed/rotational: JPM (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.44% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.15%) CORRECTION — 1W pressure vs positive 1M suggests cautious stance and tactical opportunities rather than broad risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Relatively steady but not uniform: UNH (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +3.27%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -1.22%) BELOW TREND — defensive elements present while select names show idiosyncratic weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and selected Industrials/Materials exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership (SLB, CVX, BA) and weak overall breadth; reduce exposure to stretched Tech names showing BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT) and monitor INTU/TSLA downside. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy/Industrials strength, but maintain NEUTRAL positioning until breadth improves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -9.75% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.64%) and Industrials (1W: +0.68%) given clear 1W strength; BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.20%) and Financials (1W: -1.30%) for signs of renewed pressure if megacaps fail to stabilize.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%) for sustainment of its 1M uptrend as confirmation of tech resilience; AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%) failing recent support would signal deeper consolidation; SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) holding above this week’s pivot would confirm Energy leadership; JPM (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%) reclaiming last month’s high would support Financials rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
SLB (+60): Landmark Aramco contract — SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. INTC (+50): Panther Lake/foundry optimism — INTC (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) RECOVERY, short-term confirmation but 1M divergence. ADBE (+55): AI/earnings headlines — ADBE (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +3.25%) CORRECTION, bullish news but price is diverging (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (-55): Q4 deliveries miss — TSLA (1W: -9.75% | 1M: +2.06%) CORRECTION, sentiment confirmed by sharp 1W sell-off. INTU (-55): cautious FY guidance — INTU (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. GOOGL (-45): bear-leaning analyst view — GOOGL (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY, negative sentiment with slight price divergence to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with a Value/Cyclical tilt as Energy and Industrials show the clearest strength. SLB (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is mixed megacap behavior and news-price divergences (e.g., INTC and ADBE sentiment vs 1M trends), so watch breadth and confirmation before adding net exposure.
